description: This file defines the CustomerGrain class, a Orleans grain implementing customer-related state management and behaviors such as setting customer info, adding devices, and initializing random state.

classes.name: CustomerGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain class managing customer state, including setting properties, adding devices, and random initialization.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Overrides activation to perform any setup tasks when the grain is activated.

methods.name: IntroduceSelf
methods.description: Returns a greeting string with the customer's first and last name.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets the customer ID, first name, and last name in the state.

methods.name: AddDevice
methods.description: Associates a device with the customer, adding it to the Devices list and setting ownership.

methods.name: SetRandomState
methods.description: Initializes the customer state with random data for testing or demo purposes.
